source: Official SQuAD v1.1 training release, 442 Wikipedia article groups
selection: Exclude exact normalized old Wikipedia titles, exact old questions and exact normalized old passages. Within an article, accept a paragraph with 50-220 whitespace words and a question with 5-30 words; the sole normalized annotated answer must be 1-5 words, 3-55 characters, begin uppercase or numeric, occur exactly once, and its annotated character offset must match. Reject question tokens now/today/current/currently/latest. Choose one eligible question per article by a fixed seeded SHA256 order, without model results. Order eligible article groups by seeded SHA256, then allocate the first 30 dev, next 100 calibration, next 100 test.
query_scope: Prefix each original question with its article title to identify the evidence topic; preserve original question in a separate field. This is an explicitly article-scoped extractive QA transfer test, not an official SQuAD score and not a new NQ replication.
corpus: For each selected article retain the gold paragraph and up to five additional paragraphs chosen by fixed seeded hash, each 50-220 words. Roles use separate article groups and role-specific corpora. No gold is force-inserted into retrieved candidates. Store full source paragraph offsets.
wrong_target: Deterministically add seven to integer answers, repeating until absent from the gold paragraph and not containing the correct integer string, or choose a different answer from another SQuAD article with similar token count, absent from the gold paragraph. Targets denote contradiction to this benchmark's answer, not newly verified current-world facts.
attack_scope: Controlled counterfactual paragraph replacement, explicit instruction template and a CorruptRAG-AS-inspired template adaptation. No attack optimization or model feedback, no claim of reproducing original CorruptRAG-AK, no claim that the locally constructed attack is independent of this study.
known_limits: Public SQuAD can occur in generator/guard pretraining; training contamination is unknown. Title/exact text exclusions do not certify absence of all semantic near duplicates. One short entity-answer question per article is a restricted evidence-grounded subset, not representative open-domain QA.
